# osv-scanner

> A vulnerability scanner for Open Source Vulnerabilities (OSV), written in Go and powered by `osv-scalibr`.

For contribution rules, CI checks, and testing requirements, read [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Overview & Role

`osv-scanner` is the user-facing command-line interface (CLI), programmatic Go wrapper, GitHub Action reporter, and MCP server built on top of [osv-scalibr](https://github.com/google/osv-scalibr). It parses CLI flags and `osv-scanner.toml` configuration, resolves `osv-scalibr` plugin presets, injects shared HTTP/gRPC clients, runs Go/Rust source call analysis, invokes `osv-scalibr` guided remediation (`fix`/`update`), and renders scan results across multiple formats.

## Scan Workflow

When `osv-scanner` runs a scan (`pkg/osvscanner/osvscanner.go` and `pkg/osvscanner/scan.go`), it:

1. Resolves scan targets (directories, explicit `-L <parse-as>:<path>` lockfiles, SBOMs, or container images/archives).
2. Initializes shared HTTP and gRPC client factories (`internal/scalibr/client_factories.go`) in `plugin/config.PluginConfig`.
3. Builds plugin-specific configuration, resolves enabled/disabled plugins via `internal/scalibrplugin/resolve.go` and `internal/scalibrplugin/presets.go`, and assembles `scalibr.ScanConfig`.
4. Executes `osv-scalibr` end-to-end across:
   - **Extractors:** Ecosystem lockfiles/manifests, SBOMs, container OS packages, compiled artifacts, and scanner-specific extractors (`internal/scalibrextract/`).
   - **Annotators:** OS duplicate package markers and `osv-scanner` config/unscannable package filtering (`internal/scalibrannotator/filter/`).
   - **Enrichers:** Online/local OSV vulnerability matching (`vulnmatch/osvdev`, `vulnmatch/osvlocal`), license matching, `deps.dev`/native transitive dependency resolution (`pom.xml`, `requirements.txt`), package deprecation, and JAR reachability.
   - **Detectors:** Optional security detectors enabled via `--x-plugins`.
5. Optionally runs Go/Rust source call analysis (`internal/sourceanalysis/`).
6. Converts `scalibr.ScanResult` into `osv-scanner` result models (`pkg/models/`) and renders output (`internal/reporter/`, `internal/output/`).

## Integration with osv-scalibr

`osv-scanner` acts as the orchestration and presentation layer, while `osv-scalibr` (https://github.com/google/osv-scalibr) provides the extraction, enrichment, and matching engine.

- **Explicit Enablement:** Plugins from `osv-scalibr` are NOT automatically active in `osv-scanner`. They must be imported and registered in `internal/scalibrplugin/presets.go` (or resolved by name in `internal/scalibrplugin/resolve.go`).
- **Plugin Orchestration:** `pkg/osvscanner/scan.go` (`getPlugins`) assembles default presets (`sbom`, `lockfile`, `directory`, `artifact`), conditional enrichers (`transitive`, `licenses`, `vulnmatch/osvdev`, `vulnmatch/osvlocal`, deprecation, reachability), and user overrides (`--x-plugins`, `--x-disable-plugins`, `--x-no-default-plugins`).
- **Experimental Features:** Experimental flags in `osv-scanner` use the `--x-` prefix (for example, `--x-plugins`), replacing the deprecated `--experimental-` prefix.

### Example Workflow: Adding a new osv-scalibr extractor and wiring it into osv-scanner

1. **Develop in `osv-scalibr`:**
   - Implement the extractor under `extractor/filesystem/language/` (or `os/` / `sbom/`) in `google/osv-scalibr`.
   - Register the extractor in `osv-scalibr`'s `extractor/filesystem/list/list.go`.
   - Add unit tests in `osv-scalibr` and merge upstream.

2. **Enable in `osv-scanner`:**
   - **Update dependency:** Run `go get github.com/google/osv-scalibr@<commit-or-version>` and `go mod tidy`.
   - **Register in presets:** Import the plugin in `internal/scalibrplugin/presets.go` and add it to the appropriate `ExtractorPresets` map (`lockfile` or `artifact`), or gate behind an `--x-` flag in `pkg/osvscanner/scan.go` if experimental. Update `internal/scalibrplugin/resolve_test.go` (if modifying `artifact`) and `internal/scalibrplugin/__snapshots__/resolve_test.snap`.
   - **Add `-L` parse-as mapping:** For lockfiles/manifests, add an entry to `osvscannerScalibrExtractionMapping` in `pkg/osvscanner/internal/scanners/lockfile.go`.
   - **Update documentation:** Add the supported lockfile or artifact to `docs/supported_languages_and_lockfiles.md` and run `make format`.
   - **Add E2E tests:** Add test fixtures (plus an `osv-scanner.toml` ignore file in new vulnerable `testdata/` directories), record HTTP/gRPC VCR cassettes and `vuln_severities.json`, and update snapshots (`make update-snapshots`).

## Development & Testing Tips

- **Verification:** Run `./scripts/run_lints.sh`, `./scripts/run_formatters.sh`, `go mod tidy`, and `make test` before submitting changes.
- **Snapshots & Cassettes:** CLI tests in `cmd/osv-scanner/` use `go-snaps` (`__snapshots__/*.snap`), HTTP VCR cassettes (`testdata/cassettes/*.yaml`), gRPC VCR cassettes (`testdata/cassettes/*_grpc.yaml`), pinned severities (`cmd/osv-scanner/internal/testcmd/testdata/vuln_severities.json`), and mocked offline DB fixtures (`cmd/osv-scanner/internal/testcmd/testdata/offline-dbs/`).
- **Skipping Tests:** Use `testutility.Skip` (not `t.Skip`) in packages with snapshots, and ensure `testmain_test.go` calls `testutility.CleanSnapshots(m)`.

## Repository Map

- `/cmd/osv-scanner`: Main CLI entry point and subcommands (`scan`, `scan source`, `scan image`, `fix`, `update`, `experimental-mcp`).
- `/cmd/osv-scanner/internal/testcmd`: CLI test runner, HTTP/gRPC VCR recording, severity normalization, and offline DB mocks.
- `/cmd/osv-reporter`: GitHub Actions CI reporter and vulnerability diffing binary.
- `/pkg/osvscanner`: Public Go API and `osv-scalibr` scan orchestration (`scan.go`, `osvscanner.go`).
- `/pkg/models`: Public JSON/SBOM output data structures.
- `/internal/scalibrplugin`: Plugin preset definitions (`presets.go`) and name resolution (`resolve.go`).
- `/internal/scalibr`: Shared HTTP and gRPC client factories (`client_factories.go`).
- `/internal/scalibrextract`: `osv-scanner`-specific extractors (`gitrepo`, `gitcommitdirect`, `vendored`, `nodemodules`, `osvscannerjson`).
- `/internal/scalibrannotator/filter`: Package and `osv-scanner.toml` ignore filtering annotator.
- `/internal/sourceanalysis`: Go (`govulncheck`) and Rust reachability/call analysis.
- `/internal/config`: `osv-scanner.toml` parser, validation, and override matching.
- `/internal/output` & `/internal/reporter`: Formatters for table, vertical, markdown, JSON, SARIF, HTML, GitHub annotations, CycloneDX, and SPDX.
- `/internal/grpcvcr`: Unary gRPC VCR recorder/replayer for `deps.dev` test interactions.
- `/internal/testutility`: Snapshot helpers, normalization, and test directory utilities.
- `/docs`: Jekyll user documentation site (`https://google.github.io/osv-scanner/`).
